title: Restless Tomb
description: A stone sarcophagus lies open, its heavy lid shoved aside with inhuman force. Claw marks score the interior walls where the occupant dragged itself free, and a trail of grave dirt leads off into the darkness. Whatever rose from this tomb is long gone, but it left its burial goods behind.

choices.label: Search the tomb
choices.description: The risen dead seldom take their gold with them.

outcomes.text: Coins and a corroded brooch lie scattered across the sarcophagus floor. The occupant left in a hurry.
A hidden compartment beneath the burial platform holds a small fortune in old currency. Someone was wealthy in life.
The occupant didn't go far. It lurches from the shadows as you lean into the sarcophagus, clawing at your face.

choices.label: Collect the spectral wood
choices.description: The coffin's inner frame is made of wood suffused with spectral energy.

outcomes.text: You pry apart the coffin's frame. The wood is cold to the touch and glows faintly — perfect for spectral crafting.
The wood comes apart easily, and you find wraith threads tangled in the joinery. A double haul.
A splinter of spectral wood drives into your palm as you wrench a plank free. The cold burns like fire.
You eye the claw marks on the stone and decide not to linger. The trail of grave dirt leads deeper into the dark.
